object: The failure-learning and conceptual-correction claims in the user-supplied C034-C040 fractional full-cover ledger, separated into mathematical content and operational provenance.
quantity_of_interest: Which unique claims carry scoped mathematical-learning content under current RAKL math-only credit rules, and which retained records receive zero mathematical credit?

classification_contract.mathematical_credit_unit: One unique scoped mathematical implication/result with all seven fields and proof or source evidence.
classification_contract.deduplication_rule: Repeated source, receipt, review, trace, failure, or lesson renderings of the same scoped mathematical implication count once.

seven_field_mathematical_lesson.attempted_mathematical_implication: The fractional and integral full-cover problems may restrict without loss to incomparable fusion pairs whose union is the whole ground set.
seven_field_mathematical_lesson.exact_result_or_failure: For a legal pair (E,H) on U, partition M=U\(E union H) as M_E disjoint_union M_H and set E_prime=E union M_E, H_prime=H union M_H. Then E_prime union H_prime=U, E_prime intersect H_prime=E intersect H, incomparability is preserved, and every upward-closed semi-filter covered by (E,H) is also covered by (E_prime,H_prime).
seven_field_mathematical_lesson.supported_and_competing_mathematical_cau: Supported cause: upward closure preserves membership when E and H are enlarged, while assigning each missing coordinate to only one side preserves the intersection and the old exclusive elements preserve incomparability. Competing failure modes are a cover class that is not upward closed, extra legality constraints not preserved by enlargement, or a source definition different from the desk-checked definition.
seven_field_mathematical_lesson.scope: Finite ground sets, the source ledger definition of legal incomparable fusion pairs, upward-closed semi-filters, and coverage determined by E,H in F but E intersect H not in F.
seven_field_mathematical_lesson.mathematical_falsifier: A legal source pair for which every full-union extension either changes E intersect H, destroys incomparability, or fails to cover a semi-filter previously covered under the exact registered definitions.
seven_field_mathematical_lesson.repair_or_next_mathematical_move: Bind the exact source definitions and statement identity, then obtain formal or isolated proof review before theorem promotion; use the reduction only inside that bound definition universe.
seven_field_mathematical_lesson.proof_or_source_evidence: The displayed construction and proof in C034a of the preserved external ledger; the assessment classifies it DESK_CHECK_PASS_PROOF_AUTHORITY_NONE. The argument is reproduced algebraically above rather than inferred from tests.

seven_field_mathematical_lesson.attempted_mathematical_implication: The observed values through seven complement edges suggested a universal graph-realizable ceiling rho_frac at most 2.
seven_field_mathematical_lesson.exact_result_or_failure: For the exact source-bound reconstructed U8 finite evaluator, matching exact rational primal and dual certificates have total 49/24, hence this evaluator has optimum 49/24>2. The regenerated supports differ from the missing original supports, so this is retrospective reconstruction rather than original-certificate recovery.
seven_field_mathematical_lesson.supported_and_competing_mathematical_cau: Supported cause: graph realizability and the previously observed small instances do not impose a constant-two ceiling on this fractional LP. Competing explanations retained at the authority boundary are a mismatch between the reconstructed evaluator and an unstated intended source definition, or a broader theorem with additional hypotheses not present in the frozen U8 object.
seven_field_mathematical_lesson.scope: Only the reconstructed finite full-semi-filter fractional cover LP induced by the displayed U8 and the exact evaluator bound in the v2 correction receipt; no asymptotic family, novelty, integral-cover, circuit, or P-versus-NP conclusion.
seven_field_mathematical_lesson.mathematical_falsifier: An exact primal infeasibility, exact dual infeasibility, unequal primal and dual totals, a missed registered constraint with load above one or coverage below one, or a demonstrated statement/evaluator mismatch that removes this U8 instance from the claimed class.
seven_field_mathematical_lesson.repair_or_next_mathematical_move: Replace finite extrapolation by a uniform recurrence or obstruction theorem. Treat U8 as a bounded counterexample to the ceiling only, and test any successor claim against exact relevance and transfer conditions.
seven_field_mathematical_lesson.proof_or_source_evidence: C034B_U8_RETROSPECTIVE_REPLAY_V2_CORRECTION_20260811.json records exact rational primal/dual totals 49/24 with all registered finite constraints checked, while explicitly marking retrospective target exposure and different certificate support. The receipt corroborates this finite mathematical counterexample but does not create an asymptotic proof.

seven_field_mathematical_lesson.attempted_mathematical_implication: Ground-set inclusion U subset U_prime by one complement edge was conjectured to imply rho_frac(U_prime) at least rho_frac(U).
seven_field_mathematical_lesson.exact_result_or_failure: For U={(0,0),(1,2),(2,1),(2,2)} and U_prime=U union {(1,1)}, exact finite primal-dual receipts give rho_frac(U)=3/2 and rho_frac(U_prime)=1, a strict decrease of 1/2.
seven_field_mathematical_lesson.supported_and_competing_mathematical_cau: Supported cause: the incident added edge changes row/column generators, so cylinder-lifted old semi-filters need not remain relevant and old dual constraints can disappear. Competing causes checked by the receipt include finite LP optimization error and an unmatched primal/dual bound; broader source-definition mismatch remains outside the receipt.
seven_field_mathematical_lesson.scope: The exact two displayed finite bipartite-complement instances and registered full-union finite evaluator. It refutes arbitrary one-edge monotonicity, not every restricted extension theorem.
seven_field_mathematical_lesson.mathematical_falsifier: Failure of exact feasibility for either displayed primal or dual certificate, unequal matching totals, an incorrect U subset U_prime relation, or a source-bound definition change under which the displayed finite evaluator no longer represents rho_frac.
seven_field_mathematical_lesson.repair_or_next_mathematical_move: Condition monotonic transport on relevance persistence of the supported lifted witnesses, and test that premise before using any extension as an amplification step.
seven_field_mathematical_lesson.proof_or_source_evidence: C037_EXTERNAL_LEDGER_REPLAY_RECEIPT_20260811.json gives matching exact rational primal and dual certificates for 3/2 and 1 and exhaustively checks the registered full-union finite rule spaces.

seven_field_mathematical_lesson.attempted_mathematical_implication: A parent dual certificate should transfer to a larger ground set when its supported semi-filter witnesses remain mathematically relevant after cylinder lifting.
seven_field_mathematical_lesson.exact_result_or_failure: If each cylinder lift F_hat={S_prime subset U_prime : S_prime intersect U belongs to F} in the support of a parent feasible dual remains relevant in the child, then the same weights are child dual-feasible and the child optimum is at least the parent certified mass.
seven_field_mathematical_lesson.supported_and_competing_mathematical_cau: Supported cause: cylinder membership of E_prime, H_prime, and E_prime intersect H_prime is exactly membership of their projections E,H,E intersect H; every child load is therefore an old legal-rule load or zero. Competing failure modes are loss of lifted relevance, an underdefined child legal-pair space, or a projection that does not preserve the registered coverage predicate.
seven_field_mathematical_lesson.scope: Finite U subset U_prime, the source ledger cylinder lift, a fixed supported feasible parent dual, and the explicit premise that every supported lift is child-relevant. No unconditional extension monotonicity or strict improvement.
seven_field_mathematical_lesson.mathematical_falsifier: A child legal pair whose load under the lifted weights exceeds one despite every supported lift satisfying the registered relevance premise, or a concrete failure of one of the three cylinder-membership equivalences under the exact bound definitions.
seven_field_mathematical_lesson.repair_or_next_mathematical_move: Recover and bind the exact relevance and legal-pair definitions, formally or independently review the projection argument, and construct extensions for which support persistence is proved uniformly.
seven_field_mathematical_lesson.proof_or_source_evidence: The C038 source proof explicitly derives the three cylinder-membership equivalences and the projected-load bound; the assessment verdict is CONDITIONAL_DESK_CHECK_PASS_STATEMENT_BINDING_MISSING.

seven_field_mathematical_lesson.attempted_mathematical_implication: Preserving a parent dual certificate under extension might by itself establish a recursively strict amplification chain.
seven_field_mathematical_lesson.exact_result_or_failure: The persistence lemma yields only rho_frac(child) at least the preserved parent mass. It supplies no positive gap. A strict recursive step therefore requires a separate child lower bound strictly exceeding that mass; the three reported finite increases do not prove that such gaps continue uniformly, and their named original certificates are missing from the supplied bundle.
seven_field_mathematical_lesson.supported_and_competing_mathematical_cau: Supported cause: feasibility transports the old objective value but contains no inequality forcing additional objective mass. Competing routes to strictness include reoptimization to a different child dual, an additive feasible augmentation, or a structural lower-bound argument; none follows from persistence alone.
seven_field_mathematical_lesson.scope: The C038 conditional transfer mechanism and the reported C039-C040 finite chain. This is a boundary on what the transfer lemma implies, not a claim that uniform strict amplification is impossible.
seven_field_mathematical_lesson.mathematical_falsifier: A derivation from the persistence hypotheses alone that forces a uniform positive child-parent gap for every admitted extension, or a hidden hypothesis in the exact theorem statement that already supplies such a gap.
seven_field_mathematical_lesson.repair_or_next_mathematical_move: Construct a uniform relevance-preserving extension together with an independently proved positive cumulative dual-mass recurrence, or prove a mathematical obstruction to every such recurrence.
seven_field_mathematical_lesson.proof_or_source_evidence: The conclusion of the C038 displayed theorem is non-strict, while the external ledger itself states the active residual as a separate positive cumulative dual-mass recurrence. The assessment leaves C035/C036/C040 certificate claims CANNOT_CHECK, so the reported finite chain cannot be used as certified recurrence evidence.

operational_provenance_zero_credit.reason: Chronology, schema materialization, and process-compliance separation are assurance facts, not a mathematical implication.
A solver worker hang and checkpoint fallback concern execution reliability only; missing output is not a mathematical result.
Solver stalling and constraint-generation performance are computational provenance. They receive no mathematical credit absent a separately proved mathematical implication.
Frozen-context and hash-chain chronology can support discovery-process claims only and cannot create mathematical truth or learning credit.

synthesis.central_mathematical_correction: Extension arguments must separate relevance-preserving transport of an old dual certificate from a separate proof of strict new lower-bound mass; arbitrary inclusion supplies neither.

nonclaims: This reclassification creates no new P-versus-NP theorem, asymptotic lower bound, circuit lower bound, or root-solution certificate.
It does not recover the missing C035, C036, C039, or C040 original certificates.
It is not independent mathematical review and does not establish novelty.
Artifact hashes, tests, Git state, and CI receive zero mathematical-learning credit.
